evidence: empty_void: seg4:start/mid and payoff@-0.4 waste the whole middle: a flat empty 2x2 box with a near-invisible grey '4', a mascot shrunk to ~20px in its bottom-left corner, and a dead black band between the box and the closing mascot; seg1:mid also has a large empty gap between the constellation line

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:mid and seg1:end stack four unrelated layers in one frame: a headline 'it never settled' printed on top of the scene title 'Amazon deforestation by year', a constellation-like line chart whose nodes overrun that title, a pill-shaped slider widget with a red dot, a label 'anywhere between 4571 and 27772' that collides with a mascot, plus TWO copies of Data on screen at once and a burned-in caption underneath — and the claim it draws (a range between 4571 and 27772) is not the narration's claim (750,000 km2 lost since 1970, bigger than France).
weakest_scene.root_cause: A range/uncertainty machine was composited full-frame with its own title and axis labels over a scene that already carried a title and a mascot, and a second mascot instance was placed in the same scene; nothing measured the text extents or reserved a band for the caption, and the machine chosen does not match the segment's relationship (a total/comparison, not a spread).
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Rebuild seg1 as a single full-bleed depiction of the 750,000 km2 total against France — one title, one mascot, the caption band clear of all marks, no overlapping type — and drop the range slider and the constellation line entirely.
